blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are closed sales from Jared’s Paragon export; local facts come from official sources listed at the bottom. It has no listing feed yet.

South Vancouver is an MLS® sub-area of Vancouver. From November 2025 to October 22, 2026, 89 homes sold there: 56 houses, 8 condos, 3 townhomes and 22 duplexes. 56 houses sold in South Vancouver with a median price of $1,675,000 (the middle half sold between $1,428,416 and $1,992,000), taking a median of 27 days to sell at 95.1% of the last list price; 7% sold above list.
South Vancouver home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

56 houses sold in South Vancouver with a median price of $1,675,000 (the middle half sold between $1,428,416 and $1,992,000), taking a median of 27 days to sell at 95.1% of the last list price; 7% sold above list. They had a median $696 per square foot, a median year built of 1976 and a median lot of 4,026 square feet. 22 duplexes sold in South Vancouver with a median price of $1,331,500 (the middle half sold between $1,267,500 and $1,395,500), taking a median of 32 days to sell at 97.4% of the last list price; 23% sold above list. They had a median $862 per square foot and a median year built of 2025.

items.t: The City's East Fraserlands Policy Statement refers to a combined "Victoria-Fraserview/Killarney" community.
Sunset Community Centre is on Main Street near East 49th Avenue.

R1-1 replaced all former RS zones on October 17, 2023, allowing single detached houses with suite or laneway house, duplexes, character retention, and multiplexes of 3 to 6 strata or up to 8 rental units.

The Vancouver Plan (July 2022) was converted into the city's first Official Development Plan, approved March 12, 2026; the ODP does not rezone any property and future applications must be consistent with it.

blocks.text: South Vancouver: parks, community facilities and shopping

items.t: Sunset Community Centre is listed at 6810 Main Street; it offers childcare, a fitness centre, a dance studio and a playground, and is associated with Sunset Rink and Moberly Arts and Cultural Centre (7646 Prince Albert Street).
Killarney Community Centre is listed at 6260 Killarney Street.
John Oliver Secondary School, 530 East 41st Avenue, serves grades 8 to 12; VSB gives no catchment boundary and links a locator.

faq.q: What did homes in South Vancouver sell for?
faq.a: The median house sale in South Vancouver was $1,675,000, across 56 sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in South Vancouver?
faq.a: Half sold in 27 days or less, at a median 95.1% of the last list price; 7% went over asking (sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026).

faq.q: What price range do most houses in South Vancouver sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 56 houses that sold in South Vancouver went for between $1,428,416 and $1,992,000, around a median of $1,675,000.

faq.q: Do houses in South Vancouver sell above asking price?
faq.a: 7% of the 56 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 95.1% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in South Vancouver?
faq.a: The median year built was 1976 for the 56 houses sold in South Vancouver.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in South Vancouver usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in South Vancouver had 5 bedrooms, from the 56 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Vancouver?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.
